## Activity

During October 2023, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 113 captures. This represents the site’s total capture activity for the month. The activity level provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 113 captures, 8 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.1. These images could not be used for grading, and the result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for October 2023.

## Grading

Grading identified 23 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This indicates that the typical interval for a graded image was 1, although individual cases may have taken longer or less time.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.
